newsitem.title: USA: Biopsys resolves Mommotome labeling issues.
newsitem.headline: Biopsys resolves Mommotome labeling issues.

text.p: Biopsys Medical Inc said it received confirmation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration that all issues from its February 5 warning letter concerning the labeling and promotion of the Mammotome Biopsy System have been satisfactorily resolved.
As part of the resolution, Biopsys submitted a new premarket notification for the Mommotome breast biopsy device, which it said is specifically directed towards breast biopsy for diagnostic purposes.
The premarket notification is currently under review by the FDA.
